decision.reason: [ev-f0029965e392] says only that istio-csr is affected, that `v0.12.0` does not have the fix, and that no released version had the fix when the note was written. It does not name a fixed version, so the proposed boundary `>=0.12.1` is a guess that the evidence does not support. The excerpt is also cut off before the workaround settings ("installing Istio with the following settings: …"). An exact exposure condition has to exclude environments that applied those settings, so we need the full upgrade-note text naming those settings and a release note naming the first fixed istio-csr version.
